 Darnell Washington Week 10 Outlook - Steelers at Bengals 
 By Derek Brown (FantasyPros) , Thu, Nov 12th 2026, 1:35pm EST 
 Ok, we're going back to Darnell Washington this week as a streaming option. Yep, you guessed it. It's because of single-high coverage. The last time they played Pittsburgh, they utilized single high with 59.5% of their defensive snaps. In three of their last four games, they have utilized single high 52.5-67.4% of their defensive snaps. The last time Washington faced this defense, he secured three of his four targets with 67 receiving yards (zero touchdowns). Against single high, Washington has a 27% TPRR and 2.72 YPRR. With DK Metcalf dealing with DJ Turner all game, Washington could see a decent workload. Washington is tied for the team lead with seven red zone targets and has three scores this season. He could be a TE1 this week. Over their last five games, Cincy has allowed the tenth-most yards per target to tight ends while ranking 15th in receiving fantasy points per game.
